ids_are: Local refinement case identifiers, not implemented endpoint/status/protocol enums
execution_rules: Actual PostgreSQL for transaction, locking, uniqueness, rollback and race cases; deterministic unit fixtures cannot prove those properties.

Public nonfunctional values only while qualifying a changed diagnostic/download boundary; actual native private values only after committed reviewed source/build binding, native eligibility and complete public fault qualification.
Generate/Replace uses fresh shared proof; Consume uses trusted recovery-owner context without assuming a surviving strong-factor session.
Case expectations bind explicit selected policy/profile; unselected replacement/assurance/download semantics remain pending rather than guessed.
Use fixed boolean/failure observations. No secret-valued assertions, raw exceptions, request/row exports, screenshots, HAR, traces, videos, debug logs or secret receipt fingerprints.

Every required component-owned check must actually run. Missing, false, UNKNOWN or cross-component claims reject acceptance; valid failure envelopes and public expected failures are not real-journey PASS.

cases.trigger: Absent, unsupported or mismatched native/profile version; malformed profile/count/work bounds
cases.required_observation: No fallback generator, lower-cost verifier or default production profile; no set/proof/owner mutation.

cases.trigger: Selected generation/encoding profile and forced repeated RNG results
cases.required_observation: Entropy proof covers canonicalized output; returned set and stored individual verifier cardinalities are exactly the same distinct supported count. Collision exhaustion fails finitely, never an unbounded retry.

cases.trigger: Same private test code with different owner, set/generation, purpose or profile; swapped verifier row
cases.required_observation: All cross-context uses reject. User parameter equality alone cannot satisfy binding; original intended context remains usable.

cases.trigger: Oversized, Unicode/confusable, ambiguous separator/case and structurally malformed input
cases.required_observation: Exactly the refined canonicalization contract applies before bounded work. No lossy normalization collision or TOTP-specific six-digit fallback.

cases.trigger: Issue, replace, failed issue, redeem and duplicate operations
cases.required_observation: Actual owned persistence contains only supported verifier encodings and approved metadata; native AspNetUserTokens RecoveryCodes and reversible code payloads stay absent; no raw code in outbox/config/jobs/operation result.

cases.trigger: Issue/Replace with absent, expired, consumed or insufficient-assurance proof
cases.required_observation: Owner effect, new set and disclosure do not occur. An old authenticated session alone cannot substitute for fresh required proof.

cases.trigger: One-field-at-a-time substitution of account/session/origin/operation/correlation/scope/resource/expected-version/context digest
cases.required_observation: Shared exact proof cannot authorize a different owner operation; no proof consumption or set mutation for rejected binding.

cases.trigger: Policy/source/session/set changes or proof expiry during awaited hash/owner work, including the final decision frontier
cases.required_observation: Current effective authority is rechecked at actual commit. Stale attempted issuance/replacement, proof use and outbox roll back.

cases.trigger: Concurrent duplicate Generate/Replace with identical stable operation and with same operation/different context
cases.required_observation: At most one owner mutation and one single-delivery admission; exact duplicate reconciles safe lineage, changed binding conflicts, no second code list.

cases.trigger: Owner returns conflict or throws before commit after generation/verifier work
cases.required_observation: Proof, set, individual state and outbox do not partially commit. Same authorized operation may continue only under current authority; no released values from failed commit.

cases.trigger: Commit outcome or disclosure response lost
cases.required_observation: Stable operation lookup returns safe original result/UNKNOWN only; no blind generation retry, new proof use, plaintext re-read or falsely confirmed delivery.

cases.trigger: Cross-account/object access, missing/invalid antiforgery, wrong origin, arbitrary account query, non-owner Admin/Support access
cases.required_observation: Authoritative authorization and enumeration-resistant fixed response; no credential value or existence disclosure. Secrets never enter URL/query/fragment.

cases.trigger: Valid code consumed then submitted again in a new recovery operation
cases.required_observation: One committed individual claim and owner effect. New-operation replay rejects without another effect/outbox.

cases.trigger: Two operations/sessions/processes redeem the same individual code simultaneously
cases.required_observation: Exactly one committed winner, one dependent owner effect and policy-consistent loser; no double effect or reusable detached proof.

cases.trigger: Different individual codes concurrently target the same or different trusted recovery operations
cases.required_observation: Linearization follows the refined owner policy; no assertion that both must succeed by default. No unconsumed code is accidentally consumed or reused.

cases.trigger: Trusted recovery context with no surviving password/passkey session, and separately an untrusted caller lacking recovery context
cases.required_observation: Approved fallback evidence is not made impossible by an invented prior-factor requirement; untrusted validity-oracle access remains unavailable. No final session is minted by the primitive.

cases.trigger: Dependent owner failure, source/version conflict or cancellation after private verification/claim preparation
cases.required_observation: Single-use claim, owner state and outbox share rollback; no consumed-without-effect or effect-without-consumption state.

cases.trigger: Same-operation retry after known commit or lost commit acknowledgement
cases.required_observation: Safe exact original outcome/UNKNOWN, not a second consumption or general proof. Different operation binding cannot recover another operation's result.

cases.trigger: Wrong codes, corrupted verifier encodings, finite hash-work exhaustion and attempt abuse
cases.required_observation: Finite fail-closed work and current throttling without silent cryptographic downgrade. Attempt accounting follows the existing authoritative abuse contract, including failure paths.

cases.trigger: Two replacements using the same expected current set version
cases.required_observation: One policy-consistent new generation; stale operation cannot overwrite/revalidate the old set or return a second secret list.

cases.trigger: Redemption blocked immediately before replacement commit and converse ordering
cases.required_observation: Exact selected invalidation boundary is respected in both orderings; no resurrection or post-invalidation acceptance. Replacement ordering must be refined before expectations are frozen.

cases.trigger: Consume/replacement invokes selected replenishment and notification integration
cases.required_observation: Safe versioned post-commit intent and explicit owner result; no notification contains codes. Applicable saved-code lifecycle obligations are resolved across009/011/016 without silent automatic session/factor effects.

cases.trigger: Invalidate/consume/expire, then owner cleanup and hold/restore cases under explicit policy
cases.required_observation: Validity change is distinguished from physical purge. Inventory, hold precedence, deletion/anonymization action and safe cleanup evidence are verified; no invented duration or global erasure result.

cases.trigger: Approved one-time payload and explicit requested download in the owning page
cases.required_observation: One armed download only; bounded in-child stream equals the already held payload; no read-again endpoint. Actual owned file removal and cleanup verified. This case remains contingent on refined admission semantics.

cases.trigger: Download before arming, after disarming or from another page/context/operation
cases.required_observation: Run rejects; bounded cancel/removal and process/surface checks execute. No claim that the browser could not have created a transient file before the rejection.

cases.trigger: Double click, repeated keyboard activation, popup/iframe and simultaneous second transfer
cases.required_observation: Native disabled/latch and strict admission permit at most the single authorized request; any extra download rejects, even with harmless/public bytes.

cases.trigger: Adversarial suggested filename/path, outside-root/reparse/link identity, extensionless archive or arbitrary artifact
cases.required_observation: No suggested-name-derived destination or broad extension/folder allowance. Only exact generated canonical owned identity can be inspected; every other artifact fails.

cases.trigger: Empty, wrong, oversized, incomplete or mismatched transfer
cases.required_observation: Fixed failure/false byte-equality observation; no downloaded contents, digest, URL, error string or assertion diff escapes the child.

cases.trigger: Timeout/cancel during initiation, partial transfer, stream read or deletion
cases.required_observation: Each stage is bounded, actual close/file absence/root removal checked; an abandoned promise or attempted cleanup cannot satisfy acceptance.

cases.trigger: Lost response before child holds a payload; reload/back/reopen/status recovery after consumed delivery
cases.required_observation: Nondisclosing safe original-status UI, no server re-read or replacement by polling; Download cannot operate without the currently authorized volatile payload.

cases.trigger: Done, close, unmount, operation change or cancellation after request initiation
cases.required_observation: Clear DOM/references, dispose stream/objectURL and owned QA file. Feedback says requested rather than user-saved; no promise of managed/OS memory zeroization.

cases.trigger: URL/history/referrer, local/session storage, cookies and service-worker/cache observations around reveal/download
cases.required_observation: No code or secret transport outside the exact approved response/transient DOM/download boundary; existing BFF cookie/TLS/no-store protections stay enforced; no storage-state export.

cases.trigger: Public marker in raw stdout/stderr, thrown Playwright error, assertion-like text or unhandled failure at each new download stage
cases.required_observation: Raw channels remain contained; fixed safe failed envelope only; no marker-bearing log/report/trace/screenshot/HAR/video/dump/capture. Public expected failure is not a successful recovery run.

cases.trigger: Child/controller/coordinator cancellation, malformed private control and forced-stop fallback
cases.required_observation: Known owned PID/start and canonical root ownership govern bounded cleanup; no broad kill or borrowed-service reset. Unknown close/removal rejects. New owned-resource lifecycle changes require their own actual native canary.

cases.trigger: Missing/false/unknown/extra/cross-component required predicates and otherwise valid failure envelopes
cases.required_observation: Strict schema remains distinct from accepted execution. Browser cannot assert persistence/resource facts; coordinator cannot echo browser checks.

cases.trigger: Recovery boundary extension against original TOTP v2/v3 public matrices and relevant native/public UI cohorts
cases.required_observation: TOTP downloads remain disabled/non-profile roots empty, fixed dispatch and environment/output controls intact. Reuse unchanged cohort evidence honestly; rerun only behavior-affected scopes. Edge/WebKit limitations are not waived.

cases.trigger: Refined U-AUTH-06 guard, keyboard/form/dialog/feedback states using public inert values
cases.required_observation: Approved baseline/scoped consent, safe deep-link/history behavior, shared validation, disabled duplicate protection, connected focus and safe polite status verified. Public screenshot evidence never contains a usable code; actual private correctness uses boolean receipts.

acceptance_requires: Native eligibility, committed complete owned source/build binding, approved/refined inputs, actual selected cases and relevant regressions, truthful component-owned receipts and all cleanup. No P2-009 PASS is claimed by this matrix.
